summary: Apollo Infrastructure Company LLC filed an 8-K reporting that certain indirect subsidiaries, as borrowers and guarantors, executed a first amendment and lender joinder on October 9, 2026 to a revolving credit agreement originally dated January 12, 2026. The amendment increases committed capacity by $300 million to $800 million aggregate, with an uncommitted accordion permitting $25 million incremental requests; maturity remains January 12, 2029. Sumitomo Mitsui Banking Corporation serves as administrative agent, letter of credit issuer and lead arranger, with U.S. Bank Trust Company as collateral trustee. This is a routine credit-facility upsize, not a special situation; watch borrower-level leverage and covenant headroom.
